messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Serving pool 'g4-pool-7' experiencing CUDA OOMs despite reported headroom. 14 failures in last 5m. Auto-escalating to on-call.

Jin Park: I'm on call, grabbing context. Which region? any customer-facing 5xxs?

incident-bot: region=us-west2, affected model variants: rwd-v2-large-8q4, recent deploy: d2f7a3. error: 'CUDA out of memory' in infer_worker pid=4321. headroom reported by allocator: 1.1GB

Maria Gomez: I'm joining. Can someone paste nvidia-smi + allocator summary from the node? Also log of oom trace.

Alex Li: pulling logs now. here's nvidia-smi (node g4-17):
```
Fri Mar 14 12:12:30 2025
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 534.21       Driver Version: 534.21       CUDA Version: 12.1     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap|         Memory-Usage | GPU-Util  Compute M. |
|    0  Tesla T4         Off    | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                  N/A |
|  33%   62C    P0    32W /  70W|   14728MiB / 15360MiB |     95%      Default |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

Alex Li: allocator debug from runtime endpoint `/admin/mem_stats`:
```
allocator_reserved_bytes=16441640960
allocator_free_bytes=8796093024
kv_cache_total=6.2GB
kv_cache_pinned=5.9GB
headroom_reported=1.1GB
fragmentation_est=41%
reserved_blocks=1.5GB
```

Samir Patel: that kv_cache_pinned number looks suspiciously high after the last model update. d2f7a3 added longer prefix caching by default. Could be pinned pages not evicting.

Nina Ortega: Customer-impact: several customers in us-west2 seeing 500s for chat endpoints, ~3-10% error rate over 12:05-12:14. Support ticket queue rising.

Jin Park: Immediate mitigation: (1) remove new prefix caching flag for g4-pool-7 (2) evict KV cache on affected workers (3) drain tasks from nodes with high fragmentation and restart infer_worker process. I'll take 1 and 2.

Maria Gomez: I'll coordinate draining/rolling restart with infra.

Jin Park: Executing eviction via admin API:
```
POST https://runtime.internal/admin/evict_kv?node=g4-17
Response: 202 ACCEPTED -> evicting 6.2GB KV cache async
```

Alex Li: Triggered worker restart on g4-17:
```
sudo systemctl restart infer-worker
```
Logs showing immediate OOM during restart sequence:
```
[12:13:02] infer_worker[4321]: WARNING: restoring kv cache pinned pages failed: out of memory
[12:13:03] infer_worker[4321]: CRITICAL: CUDA OOM when allocating 256MB tensor
[12:13:03] kernel: oom-killer invoked
```

Samir Patel: We should also set RUNTIME_RESERVED_BLOCKS lower on the next process spawn to avoid pre-reserving too many small blocks. current env: RUNTIME_RESERVED_BLOCKS=2048 (MB)

Nina Ortega: ETA for visible customer recovery after eviction + restart? we need to update support.

Maria Gomez: Eviction completed on two workers; observed freed GPU memory ~5.8GB on those nodes. Rolling restart in progress. Should see error rates drop within 60-90s per restarted worker as traffic shifts.

incident-bot: Update: 8/10 workers in g4-pool-7 restarted successfully. 2 still flapping due to immediate OOM on startup. Routing policy applied: route traffic away from g4-pool-7 to fallback pool rwd-v2-small for non-SLA customers.

Jin Park: For the two flapping nodes, we're going to temporarily disable auto-prefetch + start with smaller reserved blocks:
```
export RUNTIME_RESERVED_BLOCKS=1024
export PREFETCH_PREFIXES=false
systemctl start infer-worker
```

Alex Li: Did that on g4-18 and g4-19, both started cleanly. nvidia-smi now shows free memory increased on restarted nodes.

Samir Patel: Root cause hypothesis: the new default prefix caching in deploy d2f7a3 pins KV cache pages aggressively. Combined with allocator's reserved blocks policy caused fragmentation that made large contiguous allocations fail despite overall headroom.

Maria Gomez: Longer term: we should add an eviction watermark and a less aggressive pinning policy in default config, and an allocator path to compact or coalesce free blocks. Filing follow-up RFC.

Nina Ortega: Support update: "We are mitigating a GPU memory pressure issue in us-west2 causing intermittent 500s for chat. Mitigation underway, partial recovery observed. We'll post again in 30m or on full recovery." :thumbsup:

Jin Park: Postmortem action items I/O:
- rollback d2f7a3 default caching change for canary pools (Jin)
- add eviction watermark + async background eviction (Samir)
- allocator compaction design doc (Maria)
- improve runtime healthcheck to catch OOM on startup and auto-reduce reserved blocks (Alex)

ops-bot: Incident SEV2 -> acknowledged. Create postmortem: /postmortems/2025-03-14-kv-cache-fragmentation

Nina Ortega: Marking incident as 'mitigated' for now. I'll keep monitoring. Thanks everyone :heart:

Jin Park: closing rotation to on-call. If anything flaps back, re-open thread or @pagerduty. Good work.
